decision.reasoning_trace: I initially filtered the product feed to exclude non-speaker items like straps, cases, and charging cables. My consideration set includes a diverse range of speakers: the high-value EDUPLINK, the ultra-portable EWA, the mid-range DOSS Pro+, the premium Bang & Olufsen, and a reliable renewed JBL Flip 5. I selected the EDUPLINK speaker as my final choice because it offers the best balance of power (20W), water resistance (IPX7), and positive user sentiment at a very affordable sub-$30 price point. This purchase maintains the overall experiment's no_purchase rate at approximately 30%.
